The largest country in the world is Russia.

Aunt May’s knitting club was supposed to be a sanctuary of "stitch and bitch," but this week, the only thing getting bitched about was the feline culprit. Her cat, clearly feeling inspired by Hansel and Gretel, decided that the living room rug was a trail of breadcrumbs worth following. The result? A sweater’s worth of yarn had been unraveled into a chaotic, woolly mess that stretched from the armchair to the kitchen. Aunt May stood amidst the disaster, holding a single knitting needle like a scepter, wondering if she should call the police or just start a new hobby: cat detective work.
